authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 90 bundler wallets, and the top bundler traders account for 66% (top_bundler_trader_pct 0.6614). GeckoTerminal shows 2,109 unique buyers but only 109 unique sellers in h1, and those 109 sellers made 5,486 sells. That means a small set of wallets is selling over and over into a large, spread-out set of buyers. Unique buyers went from 94 (m15) to 1,411 (m30), so about 1,300 buyers arrived in one 15-minute window and then almost stopped. That looks like a scripted wallet spray, not organic discovery, and the holder count of 2,106 roughly matches the buyer count. $1.6M volume on $60k liquidity (28x h1 turnover) points to wash or bot volume. There are no socials, no website and no DexScreener profile. The only X link is a single status from an unknown account (ForListj), which I could not fetch (HTTP 402). I found no organic posts about the contract or ticker.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read X directly, and private Telegram and Discord are invisible to me. Some of the buyers may be real people. The buyer/seller asymmetry could partly come from how GeckoTerminal counts routed trades.
